author: N6rL
content:
Plan:
1. Add EnrichmentError to enricher.py (coordinator raises this when any enricher returns error).
2. Create alcanzai_understanding/coordinator.py with run_enrichment_pipeline + _apply_enrichment.
   - Sort applicable enrichers by priority, run in order, merge results between runs.
   - _apply_enrichment: grobid_blocks → doc.blocks; grobid_tei_xml → source_metadata; grobid_metadata → backfill title/authors/year/abstract_text (prefer longer abstract); everything else → source_metadata.
   - Fail fast: raise EnrichmentError on any result.error (ADR-011).
3. Fix Python 2 'except ValueError, IndexError:' syntax in grobid_enricher.py and citation_enricher.py (both files have this bug — SyntaxError in Python 3).
4. Update __init__.py to export EnrichmentError + run_enrichment_pipeline.
5. Write tests/test_coordinator.py: happy path (mock GROBID + mock citations → enriched doc), fail-fast on GROBID error, non-applicable enrichers skipped, priority ordering verified.
